meta.title: Lilis Pics — Photography Portfolio
meta.description: Documentary, portrait and editorial photography by Lili Marchetti, based in Paris.

hero.intro: Documentary, portrait and editorial photography for brands and humans who want their stories told honestly — with mood, patience, and a careful eye for light.

about.body: I've been chasing light for twelve years — through quiet apartments, packed studios, foreign streets at dawn. The work I love most sits between stillness and feeling. Whether it's your face, your brand or your ordinary tuesday, I want it to look like itself, only honest.
